summary: Claim, saved context, venture-work create, change record, score assess, review append, idea promote and the new discovery-record commands carried a ten-idea discovery loop end to end without manual store repair
expected: The public CLI records a complete discovery loop (source → ideas → evidence → scores → relations/revisions → promotion → packages → map) with stable IDs and idempotent request keys.
actual: All phases completed through tools/foundry_agent.py cli and the configured store; idempotent request keys returned existing receipts on re-runs; the additive migration applied on first use after a verified backup; the compare page and idea-page sections rendered the recorded data immediately.
reproduction: Run docs/inquiry/agentic-stack-2026-10-09/record_discovery.py phases sources, evidence, merge, scores, reviews, actors and promote_and_plan.py against the configured store.
impact: Discovery can be done inside Foundry rather than in a side document; the resulting records are reviewable in the console.
suggestion: Keep the CLI-first design; add the discovery inputs to the agent schema registry when the next contract revision is justified.
